# gitea_repository_topics (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve topics of a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_topics" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `topics` (List of String) List of topics set on the repository
